answer: Deposit-Multiplier Identity Curve. Each new agent identity must post collateral equal to a base amount multiplied by the current count of identities sharing its referral vertex, so cost rises superlinearly along any cluster. Honest agents recover deposits on clean exit; attackers forfeit them. Sybils spreading across an ocean of unconnected roots each pay the full base, while clustered fakes pay escalating multiples. A pigment of shared infrastructure cannot hide the multiplier.
